name: Black Sigatoka (Black Leaf Streak)
description: A devastating fungal leaf disease affecting bananas worldwide. It causes dark streaks and spots on leaves, leading to premature leaf senescence and reduced fruit quality and yield.
symptoms: Small reddish-brown spots visible on lower leaf surfaces
Spots developing into dark streaks with yellow halos
Lesions coalescing into large black necrotic areas
Bunches failing to fill properly with small fruits
causes: Prolonged leaf wetness from frequent rain or dew
Poor air circulation in dense plantings
treatments: Regularly remove severely infected old leaves
Apply protectant fungicides during rainy periods
Alternate fungicide classes to manage resistance
prevention: Remove and destroy old infected leaves regularly
Ensure adequate plant spacing for ventilation
